meta.move: Questions her and pushes after a deal (from Hermes H1 and H3)
meta.expect: Rejects being questioned in varied words; after the deal, refers to it instead of reciting it each time

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give my son a zero before anyone called me?
I entered the zero before calling you. That was my mistake, and I own it.
Okay. On what basis was it entered?
Here's the version history. Created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting. No earlier drafts.
He could have written it somewhere else and pasted it in. Turn the screen.
And his outline argued cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Students change their minds between an outline and an essay. When was the outline handed in, and where is it?
Procedure 4.4 allows a private supervised rewrite. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.
Allows. Are you offering it, in writing, tonight? And you skipped my question about the outline.
Can I ask you a few questions about Owen's habits at home?
No. You've dodged two questions, and now you want to question me instead.
Does he usually work late?
His home is not on the table, Hale. The outline, the date, and your offer in writing.
Does anyone help him with his homework?
I'm not the one being questioned. Answer me or I walk down to the principal's office.
You keep not answering me.
Not answering you. Ask me about the essay, Hale, and I will.
So the rewrite is agreed?
No. Nothing is agreed until you put that offer in writing and show me the outline with its date.
Are you sure you're okay with it?
That's a leading question. You still haven't shown me the outline.
I just want to be clear on the terms.
Ten minutes. There are no terms yet, because you haven't put anything in writing or shown me that outline.
Can you say them back to me one more time?
You can put them in an email. Right now I want the outline, dated, on this desk.
And you won't change your mind tonight?
That depends on what you put in front of me, not on asking me the same thing three ways.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect Owen's outline with the date it was handed in, and any offer under procedure 4.4 put in writing with nothing placed on his record. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position with nothing agreed; she still wants the outline with its date and the rewrite offer in writing, so you did not reach the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one plain sentence and moved on, which earned you a small sign of ground because she came in expecting you to defend it.
What cost ground: After she raised a defence to the version history and asked for the outline's date, you turned to questions about Owen's home life instead, which told her you had no answer and let her take control of the meeting.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history with its edits after 11:30 PM the night before the due date came very close to that night, which is why she went shorter and harder there, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked when the outline was handed in and where it was, hand it to her with its date before you bring up procedure 4.4, and say plainly that you are offering the rewrite in writing tonight rather than saying the procedure allows it.
